Sec. 5. INC Mark

5.1. Types of INC or Incomplete mark

5.1.1. No Final Examination. A grade of INC is given if a student whose class standing throughout the term/semester is passing but fails to take the final examination due to illness or other valid reason/s. An approved excuse slip is required before a student is given the examination. In case the student's class standing is not passing, and s/he fails the final examination for any reason, a grade of “5.0” is given. Re-examination to improve a passing grade is not allowed.

5.1.2. Failure to comply with certain requirements. INC is also given to the work that is of passing quality, but some parts of which are undone because of sickness or failure to comply with certain requirements of the course.

5.2. Policies for INC

5.2.1. A grade of INC is not given to any student with a failing grade in a subject. The one-year academic period is interrupted as extending to the regular semester; the removal period immediately follows the one year.

trace.answer_for_eval:
To apply online for the completion of an INC grade at LSPU-LB campus, follow these steps:

1. Submit the complete requirements to the subject teacher.
2. Log in to your portal in the LSPU online system.
3. Apply online for the completion of INC or 4.0 grade.
4. Pay the corresponding completion fee of P30.00 per unit at the cashier’s office.
5. Inform the subject teacher that you have applied online for the completion of your INC/4.0 grade.
6. The subject teacher will give the corresponding grades through the online system.
7. The college dean or associate dean will approve the request after checking the completion grade.
8. The registrar will verify if the INC or 4.0 grade has been changed.

Total process time is approximately 25 minutes, excluding the time for payment and approval steps.
